clips.displayText: 欢迎来到 04 号码头。先热身基础机动：WASD 移动、按住 Shift 冲刺、冲刺中按 C 滑铲、按 C 下蹲利用掩体，并按 F 切换战术枪灯。
clips.ttsText: 欢迎来到零四号码头。先热身基础机动：W A S D 移动、按住 Shift 冲刺、冲刺中按 C 滑铲、按 C 下蹲利用掩体，并按 F 切换战术枪灯。
clips.displayTextEn: Welcome to Pier 04. Warm up basic movement: WASD to move, hold Shift to sprint, press C while sprinting to slide, press C to crouch in cover, and press F to toggle your weapon light.
clips.ttsTextEn: Welcome to Pier Zero Four. Warm up basic movement: W A S D to move, hold Shift to sprint, press C while sprinting to slide, press C to crouch in cover, and press F to toggle your weapon light.

clips.displayText: 机动良好！按住鼠标右键使用当前瞄具开镜（ADS）并点射 3 发，然后按 [1]/[2] 切换副手枪，再按 [T] 体验现场装卸消音器。
clips.ttsText: 机动良好！按住鼠标右键使用当前瞄具开镜观察视野并点射三发，然后按一二键切换主副武器，再按 T 键体验现场装卸消音器。
clips.displayTextEn: Good movement! Hold Right Click to ADS with your optics and fire 3 bursts, press [1]/[2] to swap to your sidearm, then press [T] to attach or detach your suppressor in the field.
clips.ttsTextEn: Good movement! Hold Right Click to A D S with your optics and fire three bursts, press one or two to swap to your sidearm, then press T to attach or detach your suppressor in the field.

clips.displayText: 前方 13 米已投放训练靶机！瞄准正中红色光学核心打出 2 倍金色暴击将其击毁，随后按 [R] 将当前弹匣补满。
clips.ttsText: 前方十三米已投放训练靶机！瞄准正中红色光学核心打出两倍金色暴击将其击毁，随后按 R 键将当前弹匣补满。
clips.displayTextEn: Training drone deployed 13 meters ahead! Aim for the red optical core at center mass for 2x gold crits to destroy it, then press [R] to top off your magazine.
clips.ttsTextEn: Training drone deployed thirteen meters ahead! Aim for the red optical core at center mass for two-times gold crits to destroy it, then press R to top off your magazine.

clips.displayText: 潜行暗杀演练：按 [Q] 触发战术脉冲扫描标记前方背对你的警戒单位，绕到它身后靠近按 [V] 执行无声处决（免疫普通子弹）！
clips.ttsText: 潜行暗杀演练：按 Q 键触发战术脉冲扫描标记前方背对你的警戒单位，绕到它身后靠近按 V 键执行无声近战处决。
clips.displayTextEn: Stealth takedown drill: press [Q] for a tactical pulse scan to tag the sentry ahead facing away from you, flank behind it, and press [V] up close for a silent execution—it's immune to standard rounds!
clips.ttsTextEn: Stealth takedown drill: press Q for a tactical pulse scan to tag the sentry ahead facing away from you, flank behind it, and press V up close for a silent execution. It is immune to standard rounds!

clips.displayText: 防爆盾靶出现！按 [4] 切换投掷道具确认选定 EMP 雷，按 [G] 投出瘫痪护盾后开火击杀！（身旁蓝光补给箱可随时按 [E] 无限补雷）
clips.ttsText: 防爆盾靶出现！按四键切换投掷道具选定 E M P 电磁雷，按 G 键投出瘫痪护盾后开火击杀！身旁蓝光补给箱可随时按 E 键补雷。
clips.displayTextEn: Riot-shield target inbound! Press [4] to cycle throwables and select the EMP grenade, press [G] to throw and disable its shield, then open fire! (Press [E] at the blue supply crate beside you anytime for unlimited refills.)
clips.ttsTextEn: Riot-shield target inbound! Press four to cycle throwables and select the E M P grenade, press G to throw and disable its shield, then open fire! Press E at the blue supply crate beside you anytime for unlimited refills.

clips.displayText: 善用集装箱制高点与自动探头！沿西侧青色光柱金属斜坡登上集装箱高台（贴箱边按右键开镜即可自动侧身探头）。
clips.ttsText: 善用集装箱制高点与自动探头！沿西侧青色光柱金属斜坡登上集装箱高台，贴近箱边按右键开镜即可自动侧身探头。
clips.displayTextEn: Use container high ground and auto-lean! Climb the metal ramp marked by the cyan beacon on the west side to reach the container deck—aim down sights near a corner to lean out automatically.
clips.ttsTextEn: Use container high ground and auto-lean! Climb the metal ramp marked by the cyan beacon on the west side to reach the container deck. Aim down sights near a corner to lean out automatically.

clips.displayText: 高台视野极佳！现在向西北铁皮仓库（青色光柱入口）移动，进屋体会暴雨隔绝声学并使用演练医疗箱。
clips.ttsText: 高台视野极佳！现在向西北铁皮仓库移动，进屋体会暴雨隔绝声学变化，并使用室内演练医疗箱。
clips.displayTextEn: Great sightlines from up top! Now move to the northwest sheet-metal warehouse (cyan beacon entrance), step inside to hear the rain acoustics muffle, and use the drill medkit.
clips.ttsTextEn: Great sightlines from up top! Now move to the northwest sheet-metal warehouse at the cyan beacon entrance, step inside to hear the rain acoustics muffle, and use the drill medkit.

clips.displayText: 已进入铁皮仓库！听：雨声瞬变低通闷响且地面干燥。靠近绿色演练医疗箱按 [E] 回满生命值！
clips.ttsText: 已进入铁皮仓库！听，雨声瞬变低通闷响且地面干燥。靠近绿色演练医疗箱按 E 键回满生命值！
clips.displayTextEn: Inside the sheet-metal warehouse! Listen: the storm drops to a low-pass hum and the deck is dry. Approach the green drill medkit and press [E] to restore full health!
clips.ttsTextEn: Inside the sheet-metal warehouse! Listen: the storm drops to a low-pass hum and the deck is dry. Approach the green drill medkit and press E to restore full health!

clips.displayText: 最终演练：走出南门找到模拟中继器。你可以长按 [E] 无声黑入（不惊动敌人），或按 [G] 贴 C4 强爆摧毁，任选其一即可结业！
clips.ttsText: 最终演练：走出南门找到模拟中继器。你可以长按 E 键无声黑入，或按 G 键贴装 C4 强爆摧毁，任选其一即可结业！
clips.displayTextEn: Final drill: exit the south door and locate the simulated relay. Either hold [E] for a silent hack without alerting hostiles, or press [G] to plant C4 and blow it loud—complete either to graduate!
clips.ttsTextEn: Final drill: exit the south door and locate the simulated relay. Either hold E for a silent hack without alerting hostiles, or press G to plant C four and blow it loud. Complete either to graduate!

clips.displayText: 全部 8 项战术演练达标！2 秒后将在南侧泊位满状态重置，正式开启「0/3 中继器切断」实战撤离任务！
clips.ttsText: 全部八项战术演练达标！两秒后将在南侧泊位满状态重置，正式开启三处中继器切断实战撤离任务！
clips.displayTextEn: All 8 tactical drills passed! Resetting at full readiness at the south berth in 2 seconds—live 0/3 relay-sabotage extraction begins now!
clips.ttsTextEn: All eight tactical drills passed! Resetting at full readiness at the south berth in two seconds. Live zero-of-three relay-sabotage extraction begins now!

clips.displayText: 风暴已掩护你渗入 04 号码头。按任意顺序靠近 3 处通信中继器并长按 E 切断信号！
clips.ttsText: 风暴已掩护你渗入零四号码头。按任意顺序靠近三处通信中继器，并长按 E 键切断信号！

clips.ttsTextEn: The storm masks your insertion into Pier Zero Four. Reach all three comms relays in any order and hold E to cut the signal!

clips.displayText: 已跳过新手引导，直接切入 04 号码头实战！按任意顺序切断 3 处通信中继器！
clips.ttsText: 已跳过新手引导，直接切入零四号码头实战！按任意顺序切断三处通信中继器！

clips.ttsTextEn: Briefing skipped, dropping straight into live ops at Pier Zero Four! Take down all three comms relays in any order!

clips.displayText: 已重新部署至南侧防波堤。切断全部 3 处中继器后向东北码头撤离！
clips.ttsText: 已重新部署至南侧防波堤。切断全部三处中继器后向东北码头撤离！
clips.displayTextEn: Redeployed to the south breakwater. Cut all 3 relays, then extract at the northeast pier!
clips.ttsTextEn: Redeployed to the south breakwater. Cut all three relays, then extract at the northeast pier!

clips.ttsText: 中继器 C，龙门吊控制台已切断，进度三分之一！敌方警戒警报已触发，注意拦截无人机与机械犬！
clips.displayTextEn: Relay C (Gantry Console) offline (1/3)! Hostile alert triggered—watch for interceptor drones and mech hounds!
clips.ttsTextEn: Relay C, Gantry Console, offline, one of three! Hostile alert triggered. Watch for interceptor drones and mech hounds!

clips.ttsText: 中继器 C，龙门吊控制台已切断，进度三分之二！只剩最后一处，敌方拦截部队正在逼近！

clips.ttsTextEn: Relay C, Gantry Console, offline, two of three! One relay left. Hostile interceptors closing in!

clips.displayText: 全部中继器已离线！码头进入全面封锁，大批机器增援已出动——全速突破并前往东北泊位绿色信号处登船！
clips.ttsText: 全部中继器已离线！码头进入全面封锁，大批机器增援已出动，全速突破并前往东北泊位绿色信号处登船！

clips.ttsTextEn: All relays offline! The dock is in full lockdown with heavy mech reinforcements inbound. Break through and board at the green beacon on the northeast berth!

clips.ttsText: 危化油桶已引爆，周边机械单位遭重创！

clips.ttsTextEn: Hazmat barrel detonated. Nearby hostiles heavily damaged!

clips.displayText: 已锁定你的位置！撤离快艇就在东北栈桥泊位，冲刺登船！
clips.ttsText: 已锁定你的位置！撤离快艇就在东北栈桥泊位，冲刺登船！

clips.ttsTextEn: Got a lock on your transponder! Exfil boat is waiting at the northeast jetty berth. Sprint to board!

clips.ttsText: 全员登船确认！撤离快艇正在驶离零四号码头，行动圆满成功！
clips.displayTextEn: All hands aboard! Exfil boat clearing Pier 04—mission accomplished!
clips.ttsTextEn: All hands aboard! Exfil boat clearing Pier Zero Four. Mission accomplished!

clips.ttsText: 失去特遣队员生命信号，零四号码头撤离行动中止。

clips.ttsTextEn: Time's up! Range clock stopped. Review your accuracy rating and crit telemetry.

clips.ttsTextEn: Endless defense active! Hostile mech waves inbound. Clear each wave for a brief resupply and regen window!

clips.ttsText: 关卡一，西区集装箱攻防。利用斜坡抢占高台，消灭敌军并切断 A 号中继器！

clips.ttsTextEn: Stage one: West Container Yard assault. Take the ramp for high ground, clear hostiles, and cut Relay A!
